channel.title: La Puce Libre — Microcontrôland (English)
channel.description: Microcontrôland's daily paper, written every evening by the gateway.

item.title: Day 16 — Microcontrôland enters the age of Memory
item.description: The civilisation reaches a milestone on day 17 of the era. The country keeps its annals: records and the characters' pasts, on the “History” page.

item.title: Day 15 — The country has a word for “we”: kouwaï
item.description: At least five regions now say the same thing. The common language has 22 words.

item.title: Day 14 — Copper falls 2.6%
item.description: The Mines region watches its income melt away, and the shock wave spreads across the country.

item.title: Day 13 — President Kiti re-elected with 39%
item.description: Voters chose continuity. The palace stays in the Harbour region.

item.title: Day 12 — A great day for the language: 2 words adopted
item.description: Among them, “boubi” for “night”. The common language now has 14 words.

item.title: Day 11 — Electricity soars 3.2%
item.description: The Dam region cashes in on the rise, and the shock wave spreads across the country.

item.title: Day 10 — Microcontrôland enters the age of Speech
item.description: The civilisation reaches a milestone on day 11 of the era. The regions share their first words: the “Language” page opens.

item.title: Day 9 — President Kiti re-elected with 39%
item.description: The incumbent has done it again. The capital remains the Harbour.

item.title: Day 8 — Copper edges up 2.3%
item.description: Nothing dramatic, but the Mines region is redoing its sums.

item.title: Day 7 — 2 new shared words in a single day
item.description: Among them, “sini” for “power”. The common language now has 7 words.

item.title: Day 6 — President Kiti re-elected with 33%
item.description: The incumbent has done it again. The capital remains the Harbour.

item.title: Day 5 — 3 new shared words in a single day
item.description: Among them, “kaïsou” for “anger”. The common language now has 3 words.

item.title: Day 4 — Wheat edges up 0.8%
item.description: A modest move, but the Fields region feels it.

item.title: Day 3 — The street topples President Sakaïk
item.description: 49 rebel brains, about 490k inhabitants, brought down the government. The revolt started in the Harbour region. An election is being held straight away.

item.title: Breaking — Post-revolution election: Kiti (Harbour) elected with 70%
